## One symbol carries a whole movement {#iv1-finish .vector-lesson}

$$\mathbf a+\mathbf b-\mathbf a=\mathbf b$$

The opening journey worked without knowing any lengths or angles.

::: {.fragment}
Vector diagrams let us **add**, **subtract** and **scale** directed quantities in 2D and 3D.
:::

::: {.takeaway .fragment}
I can use vector diagrams to add, subtract and scale vectors.
:::

<div class="booklet-cue">Complete the Key Ideas boxes on pp. 5 and 13.</div>

::: notes
Ask students to explain one operation without a calculation: how does addition work, which direction does a−b point, or what does a negative multiplier do? Return to the movement cancellation and to NM=a in Example 2.4. Familiar geometry remains useful; vectors provide a language for abstracting and calculating with the relationships. Check the observable success criterion before assigning homework.
:::
